# OSS Labs

> A community of open source engineers building developer tools together.

## Overview

OSS Labs operates under ossl.dev. The GitHub organization is github.com/ossl-dev.

## Mission

Open source tools that solve real problems. Each project exists because someone needed it badly enough to build it.

## How It Works

1. **Solve real problems.** Trends don't get chased, and working code doesn't get rewritten because a new framework dropped.
2. **Small is a feature.** Libraries that do one thing well beat frameworks that do everything adequately.
3. **Earn the keys.** Write code, review PRs, help with issues. Do all three consistently and commit access follows.

## Projects

- [genesis](https://ossl.dev/projects/genesis): Reproducible dev environments defined as code. One command to provision the exact same toolchain, SDKs, and config across any machine. TypeScript. Docs: genesis-docs.vercel.app.
- [zinc](https://ossl.dev/projects/zinc): Cross-language shared memory in Rust. Zero-copy data sharing between processes with bindings for C, Python, Node, and Go. Rust. Docs: zinc.ossl.dev.
- [pylon](https://ossl.dev/projects/pylon): API versioning that does not require restructuring your codebase. Works with Express, Fastify, Hono, and anything shaped like middleware. TypeScript.
- [differens](https://ossl.dev/projects/differens): A diff engine that tells you what actually happened to your code, moved, renamed, extracted, reformatted, instead of which lines changed. Algorithm-first, AI-optional, works with or without git. TypeScript. Docs: differens.ossl.dev. npm: differens.

## Tech Stack

- **Framework:** SvelteKit (fully static generation)
- **Package manager:** Bun
- **Hosting:** Vercel
- **Domain:** ossl.dev

## Community

- [GitHub](https://github.com/ossl-dev)
